resources.string: Enter this code in Home Assistant
Not paired. In Home Assistant open Settings, Devices and services and add Shelly Elevate. The display shows a code to enter there.
The integration API is not running yet
It can no longer control this display until it pairs again.
Dashboard logged in by Home Assistant as %1$s
Home Assistant refused the dashboard login of %1$s. The integration sends a new one.
Bluetooth proxy via Home Assistant integration
Sends Bluetooth advertisements to the paired Shelly Elevate integration. Nothing is scanned until it is connected.
Voice assistant via Home Assistant integration
The wake word and microphone run on the display and the paired Shelly Elevate integration runs the Assist pipeline.
